description_en: Modifies the blocking direction, expiration time, or reason of an existing blocking policy. Calling this operation on an inactive policy activates the blocking
description_zh: 修改已有策略的封禁方向、过期时间或原因；对未生效策略调用时会启用封禁
name: UpdateBlockingPolicy

parameters.help_en: Required. The object type of the blocking target. Valid values: ip (IPv4) and domain (domain name)
parameters.help_zh: 必填。封禁对象类型，仅支持 ip（IPv4）或 domain（域名）
parameters.name: blocking_type

parameters.help_en: Required. The blocking target. For the ip type, specify a single IPv4 address. IPv6, CIDR blocks, and 0.0.0.0 are not supported. For the domain type, specify a domain name. IP literals and wildcards (*) are not supported. The domain name must contain a dot and cannot exceed 253 bytes
parameters.help_zh: 必填。封禁对象。ip 类型须为单个 IPv4 地址，不支持 IPv6、CIDR 或 0.0.0.0；domain 类型须为域名，不支持 IP 字面值或通配符 *，须包含点，长度不超过 253 字节
parameters.name: blocking_entity

parameters.help_en:
Required. The blocking direction. Valid values:
in: inbound.
out: outbound.
bidirectional: both directions.

The domain type supports only out
parameters.help_zh: 调用时必填。in 表示入方向，out 表示出方向，bidirectional 表示双向；domain 类型仅支持 out
parameters.name: blocking_direction

parameters.help_en: The updated blocking reason. If you omit this parameter, the existing reason is cleared. To retain the original reason, pass the original value in again
parameters.help_zh: 更新后的封禁原因。省略时清空原有原因；需要保留时请重新传入原值
parameters.name: blocking_reason

parameters.help_en: The blocking expiration time, in UNIX millisecond timestamp. If you omit this parameter or set it to 0, the policy never expires. A non-zero value must not be earlier than the time of the call. Omitting this parameter does not retain the original expiration time. To retain the original value, pass it in again
parameters.help_zh: 封禁过期时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳。省略或传 0 表示永不过期；非零值不得早于调用时刻。省略不会保留原过期时间，需要保留时请重新传入原值
parameters.name: blocking_expire_time

parameters.help_en: The ID of the associated security event. This parameter is optional and is not used to locate the blocking policy. Modifying only this field does not constitute a valid policy modification, and the association is not guaranteed to be included in all newly created tasks
parameters.help_zh: 关联安全事件 ID，可不传；不用于定位封禁策略。仅修改本字段不构成有效策略修改，也不保证所有新建任务都携带该关联
parameters.name: incident_id

schema.description_en: The processing result of this request

Data.description_en: The business result returned by this operation
Data.description_zh: 本次操作返回的业务结果

TaskItems.description_en: The list of blocking or unblocking tasks created by this operation. Synchronously updated records are not included. This list is empty when only the expiration time or reason of an active policy is modified, which does not indicate a failure
TaskItems.description_zh: 本次新增的封禁或解封任务列表，不包含同步更新记录。已生效策略仅修改过期时间或原因时为空，不表示失败

items.description_en: The information about an asynchronous task created by this operation
items.description_zh: 一条本次新建的异步任务信息

BlockingDirection.description_en: The direction of this asynchronous task. A value of in indicates inbound. A value of out indicates outbound. When an active policy switches from one direction to another, an unblocking task for the old direction and a blocking task for the new direction are created. When switching between unidirectional and bidirectional, tasks are created only for the added or removed direction. When an inactive policy is activated as bidirectional, separate inbound and outbound tasks are created
BlockingDirection.description_zh: 本条异步任务的方向，in 表示入方向，out 表示出方向。已生效策略单向换向会创建旧方向解封和新方向封禁任务；单向与双向之间转换时，只为新增或移除的方向创建任务。未生效策略按双向启用时，分别创建入方向和出方向任务

BlockingEntity.description_en: The IPv4 address or domain name of the blocking target
BlockingEntity.description_zh: 封禁对象的 IPv4 地址或域名

BlockingType.description_en: The object type of the blocking target. A value of ip indicates an IPv4 address. A value of domain indicates a domain name
BlockingType.description_zh: 封禁对象类型。ip 表示 IPv4 地址，domain 表示域名

TaskType.description_en: The type of this asynchronous task. A value of 0 indicates manual blocking. A value of 2 indicates manual unblocking. Synchronous configuration modification records are not included
TaskType.description_zh: 本条异步任务的类型。0 表示手动封禁，2 表示手动解封；不包含同步修改配置的记录

TaskUuid.description_en: The UUID of the created task. You can pass this value to the TaskUuids parameter of DescribeBlockingTaskStatus to query the execution result
TaskUuid.description_zh: 本条新建任务的 UUID，可传入 DescribeBlockingTaskStatus 的 TaskUuids 查询执行结果

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned when the request fails. An empty string is returned when the request succeeds. For example, InvalidParam indicates that the request parameters are invalid and does not represent the error code of a successful response
ErrorCode.description_zh: 请求失败时的错误码；成功时为空字符串。示例 InvalidParam 表示请求参数无效，不代表成功响应的错误码

Message.description_en: The result description of this request. The value is success if the request succeeds, or an error description if the request fails
Message.description_zh: 本次请求的结果说明；成功时为 success，失败时返回错误说明

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to troubleshoot and trace this request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于排查和定位本次请求

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the API call is successful. A value of true indicates that the request is processed successfully. A value of false indicates a failure. For asynchronous operations, a successful response does not indicate that the task has completed
Success.description_zh: 本次接口调用是否成功。true 表示请求处理成功，false 表示失败；异步接口的成功不表示任务已经执行完成
